decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component system extends the firm's core coating know-how into heavy corrosion protection, it remains listed through 2024, and with no shortfall against aspiration there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The low-pressure injection pump sits close to the established offer and has kept its own dedicated page, which signals ongoing commitment at a low incremental cost to carry.
This multi-model low-pressure transfer pump line reuses the proven air motors, so it shares resources with the core business and adds little risk while performance meets expectations.

Fire protection flow monitoring is somewhat more peripheral, but it keeps a dedicated page and fits the digitalization goal, and the firm's slack lets it carry the product while its results are still uncertain.
The hydraulic two-component system launched only in 2024 and is close to the core offer, so it is too early to judge it against aspirations and dropping it now would be premature.
